name: make_latex_no_args
why: Wrong argc prints usage and returns 1 (make_latex.py:23-25).

name: make_latex_non_numeric
why: int(argv[1]) raises ValueError -- an uncaught traceback, not a friendly message (make_latex.py:27).

name: make_latex_happy
why: stdout is NOT pure LaTeX: two '%'-prefixed progress lines precede the document (make_latex.py:28-32). They are valid LaTeX comments, so piping to pdflatex still works -- which is presumably the point.

name: make_pdf_happy
why: Writes <route_id>.pdf into the CWD. Unlike make_latex.py the progress text is NOT comment-escaped, since it goes to a terminal rather than a pipe (make_pdf.py:28-38).
